definitions.full: H4703. mitsad [ מִצְעָד ] noun [masculine] step ; — plural suffix בְּמִצְעָדָיו Dan 11:43 i.e. at his heels, in his train; construct, figurative of course of life, מִצְעֲדֵינֶֿבֶר Psa 37:23 (|| דַּרְכּוֺ ), Prov 20:24 . II. צעד (√ of following; meaning unknown).
